description: Navigate to The Metropolitan Museum of Art website (metmuseum.org) and search for 'Vincent van Gogh'. Apply filters to show only 'Open Access' items and 'Paintings'. Select 3 distinct paintings. Create a bookmark folder named 'Met Van Gogh' and bookmark these 3 pages. Download the high-resolution image (Original or Large) for ONE of the paintings to '~/Documents/met_images/'. Finally, create a JSON catalog file at '~/Documents/exhibition_catalog.json' containing an array of objects for the 3 paintings, each with keys: 'title', 'date', 'medium', 'accession_number', and 'url'.
